commands.name: up
commands.description: Run Kopi and create a new target database.

options.name: --config
options.description:
Optional. Path to the configuration file.
Optional. Target a specific replica by its config file.

options.name: --password
options.description:
Optional. Specify fixed password for the database.
down                   Teardown the target database created by Kopi.

options.name: -all
options.description:
Optional. Tear down all Kopi-managed replicas.
status, -s, --status   Check the status of the all Kopi Docker instances.
version, -v, --version Show version information and exit.
help, -h, --help       Show this help message and exit.
